title: Fixed Open-Reel Push Mower
description: One original complete fixed-pose hand-push reel mower appearance. Two large grounded side wheels surround an open transverse reel made of continuous thick twisted longitudinal strips on two radial spiders and a central axle. A low separate bed-bar, small rear full roller and paired rising push frame with cross-grip complete the tool. No hopper, engine cover, snow casing, chute or crop feed trough; not an old machine with parts removed. Static blunt game-art prop only: no blade contact, motion, transmission, cutting, grass processing, ergonomics, capacity, manufacturing or safety claim.
